subject.title: Require Codex scan artifact coverage proof

question: Should ClawHub enforce fail-closed artifact_coverage proof on benign Codex scan worker outputs before a clean ClawScan result can be stored?
rationale: The patch changes the authoritative scan trust boundary and can turn previously accepted benign worker outputs into retries or failures, which is a maintainer security/rollout decision rather than a mechanical code fix.

options.title: Accept Fail-Closed Contract
options.body: Land the PR after maintainer review, treating missing or incomplete benign coverage proof as a worker failure until the model output complies.

options.title: Stage As Diagnostics First
options.body: Ask for a follow-up shape that records coverage diagnostics without immediately blocking clean storage, then enforce after operational confidence.

options.title: Pause Coverage Enforcement
options.body: Keep the draft paused or close it until maintainers settle the permanent Codex worker output contract.

recommendation.title: Accept Fail-Closed Contract
recommendation.body: Land the PR after maintainer review, treating missing or incomplete benign coverage proof as a worker failure until the model output complies.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main work changed the same worker prompt, runCodex path, and ClawScan shadow surfaces that would absorb this rollout decision.
